calling_convention: Windows x64 normal native service(Context32*,argv{canonical Class mirror},Pool128*,op0) -> normal Object[3] or NULL

pool.48: QWORD normally selected String Class descriptor

row.0: DWORD status:0 no attribute,1 enclosing method,2 enclosing class only,3 unsupported metadata
row.4: DWORD enclosing holder type ID, UINT32_MAX if absent

semantics.method_index_zero: Fresh Object[3] containing canonical enclosing Class mirror,NULL,NULL
semantics.method_index_nonzero: Fresh Object[3] containing canonical enclosing Class mirror,new normal String(name),new normal String(descriptor)
semantics.holder_resolution: Original defining-loader namespace resolution; no global-name substitution or represented/enclosing Class initialization
semantics.namespace_capacity: Directory and active JCLS capacities need not equal. Normal typeid validates the receiver in active JCLS; the source directory separately bounds its row; an enclosing holder must exist in the active JCLS. This permits a source-proven generated tail to remain unbound in a smaller component image.
semantics.text: Original modified UTF8 is decoded by the existing raw Class parser, then projected as UTF16LE including surrogate code units
semantics.allocation_order: After any needed normal String class ensure and metadata validation: fresh Object[3], canonical holder mirror, fresh name String, fresh descriptor String

temporary_references.GC_domain: Existing explicit quiescent nonmoving collector only; collection cannot overlap an active Java/native call
temporary_references.callbacks: The only Java initializer callback is normal String.ensure before temporary array/String allocation
temporary_references.after_first_temporary_oop: Only noncollecting boom_heap_alloc,boom_object_new,boom_java_class_load and the local pure MASM String factory; no Java callback or safepoint
temporary_references.canonical_holder: boom_java_class_load publishes canonical Class mirrors to the existing permanent JCLS root span
temporary_references.returned_array: Elements are published into the fresh normal reference array as constructed; caller obtains result in the ordinary native return path
temporary_references.failure: Return NULL with original error Context; unreturned partial objects remain owned by the normal heap and are collectible after quiescence

errors.existing_kind_or_pending: Preserve all32 Context bytes and return NULL
errors.VMplan: Opaque Context+24, never interpreted or cleared
errors.native_allocation_failure: Builtin OOM kind3, no fabricated Throwable/caller
errors.unknown_type_or_unresolved_source_holder: Explicit unsupported kind20; never pretend no attribute

source_api: Explicit original summary/classes/selection/normalFrames/layouts/runtime-type archive plus optional generated expansion; all raw Class/MUTF8 and loader resolution use the existing original source readers
source_verification_scope: Optional exact existing full SourceV link, separate from raw metadata projection, machine equality and native behavior
future_GC_boundary: Any future automatic collection, safepoint or Java callback after temporary allocation requires explicit temporary-root integration before it is supported
